description: Check that every claim in an evidence bundle has enough independent, fresh, quote-verified support — Checks a bundle an agent assembled before answering: each claim must be backed by at least N evidence items from distinct source groups, each item's quote must actually appear in the supplied text (with offsets), publication dates must be within the caller's maximum age relative to a caller-supplied asOf, and duplicates are collapsed. Does not fetch URLs or judge whether a source is reliable or wh

asOf.description: Reference instant (ISO 8601) for age checks; required with maxAgeDays. The check never reads the clock.

evidence.description: Up to 300 items; 300000 characters of text in total.

claimIds.description: Claims this item is offered for.

sourceGroup.description: Independent-source key (publisher/owner). Overrides the host reduction.

text.description: Source text the quote should appear in.

maxAgeDays.description: Evidence published longer ago than this (relative to asOf) is stale.

requireQuotes.description: Evidence without a verifiable quote does not count as support. Default true.

name: evidence-bundle-check
